seoTitle: How to Cash Out & Withdraw Money on Squarespace
metaDescription: Learn how to withdraw your Squarespace store earnings by setting up a payout method through Stripe, PayPal, or Square.
intro: Once your Squarespace store starts making sales, you need a payout method set up to actually receive your earnings. This guide covers finding the payments settings and connecting Stripe, PayPal, or Square so funds move from your store to your bank account.

steps.heading: Log in to your account dashboard
steps.body: Go to the Squarespace website, click your profile picture or Login, and access your Account Dashboard.

steps.heading: Open the Payments section
steps.body: In your site's dashboard, use the search bar and type "payments" to reach your payment settings.

steps.heading: Choose a payout method
steps.body: Squarespace supports Stripe, PayPal, and Square (U.S. only) — pick the option that best fits how you want to receive funds.

steps.heading: Connect your account details
steps.body: Set up your chosen payout option by linking your bank account or PayPal, entering your details accurately to avoid delays.

steps.heading: Verify and monitor payouts
steps.body: Double-check your payment info stays up to date so payouts process smoothly and on time.

faq.question: Which payout methods does Squarespace support?
faq.answer: Squarespace currently supports Stripe, PayPal, and Square, with Square limited to U.S.-based sellers.

faq.question: How long does it take to receive a payout?
faq.answer: Payout timing depends on your chosen processor, but keeping your account details accurate and up to date helps avoid delays.

faq.question: Can I use more than one payout method?
faq.answer: You can connect multiple options like Stripe and PayPal, giving you flexibility in how you receive funds.

faq.question: Why hasn't my payout arrived yet?
faq.answer: Delayed payouts are often caused by outdated or incorrect bank or account details, so verify your payment info is current.
